newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain plans to develop strips market - Ferrer.
newsitem.headline: Spain plans to develop strips market - Ferrer.

text.p: Spain wants to develop the strips market and is close to changes needed to help it evolve, Federico Ferrer, deputy director for foreign financing at the Spanish Treasury told RFTV in Tokyo on Wednesday.
"The government is fully persuaded of the positive contribution of the strip market to increase liquidity of debt market issues," Ferrer said.
Tax measures made this difficult, but Ferrer said institutional changes to enhance the market should be made in the next few months.
